subject: HelixCore POC — merge conflict blocking demo window (requesting short trial top‑up)
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@helixcore.io>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@helixcore.io>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Merge conflict in connector branch blocking our integration tests

Hi Chloe,

Quick one from our side — we hit a blocker this morning while trying to merge the HelixCore adapter into our staging environment. The last pull from your SDK team introduced a schema change in the authentication handshake; our integration tests now fail with a persistent merge conflict that prevents any of our end‑to‑end tests from completing. We were planning to run the full demo pipeline next Tuesday (Nov 10) and validate throughput on your hosted sandbox, but engineers are stuck on the conflict.

Given the delay, we're running low on sandbox credits and the demo window is tight. Is there any way Redwood can: 1) issue a short top‑up of sandbox credits to keep our CI going for another week, or 2) grant a 10–14 day trial extension while we resolve the merge and get the tests green? We really want to keep the Nov 10 demo but won't be able to if we exhaust quota mid‑fix.

I've attached the merge error log and a short snippet showing the failing test. Happy to hop on a call with your eng team if that helps.

Attachments: merge_error_log.txt (text), failing_test_snippet.patch (text)

— Amit
Amit Shah
Head of Integrations, HelixCore
amit@helixcore.io

Subject: Re: Merge conflict in connector branch blocking our integration tests

Hi Amit — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs.

I'm looping in Ben and Dylan from our Solutions/Eng teams so we can triage ASAP. Ben — can your eng crew take a look at the patch and tell us how long a fix would take? If we can get a small stop‑gap (hotfix or rollback) today we may be able to keep the demo slot.

Amit — we try to avoid blanket extensions, but given the demo timing and the merge causing CI to stall I can escalate a short credit top‑up while engineering works the patch. Before I do that, can you confirm: 1) approximate credit burn rate for another week of CI (tokens/embeddings estimate), and 2) whether procurement needs a PO/DocuSign for any extension? Also cc'd procurement@helixcore.io in case they want to flag billing constraints.

I'll follow up after Ben's assessment.

Best,

Operational ask: we can provision a one‑time sandbox credit top‑up of 50k tokens (enough for ~7 full CI runs and a short demo) and a 10‑day trial extension for HelixCore under the following conditions: 
- HelixCore engineering merges the hotfix branch and validates CI within 72 hours,
- They sign the attached mutual action plan (MAP) addendum to confirm demo dates and success criteria,
- Any additional credits beyond the 50k will require procurement signoff.

If that sounds good, Chloe — I can approve the top‑up now and produce the MAP PDF for signature. I've attached a quick vendor quote in case procurement wants numbers.

- One‑time sandbox credit top‑up: 50,000 tokens (applied within 1 hour of this email).
- Trial window extension: +10 calendar days from your existing trial expiration (to give you time to complete validation and the Nov 10 demo).
- Condition: sign the attached MAP addendum confirming the demo date and success criteria, and merge the hotfix branch within 72 hours.

I've attached the proposed MAP (proposed-MAP-v2.pdf) and included the vendor numbers for procurement. Procurement: if you need a DocuSign or PO to accept the MAP amendment, please reply and we'll route a DocuSign link.
